title: AMLR Obliged Entity Scope Mapper
description: Map your legal entity to AMLR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1624) obliged entity categories (Art. 3). Determines AML/CFT obligations under the EU Single Rulebook. Applies 10 Jul 2027.
